_about.title: Simply Sub catalog API: example requests and responses
_about.purpose: The API contract for milestone M2. Every example body is validated against the API's Zod response schemas in tests (PROJECT-PLAN.md task M2.7).
_about.dataDisclaimer: All prices, dates and URLs are illustrative. Never seed the catalog from this file.

conventions.envelope: Success: { data, meta }. Failure: { error: { code, message, details? } }.
conventions.docKeys: Keys starting with '_' are documentation notes and never appear in real responses.
conventions.optionalFields: Optional fields are omitted when empty or unknown. For example, a provider without acceptedNetworks means 'unknown', so every card is allowed; a provider without availableIn sells where it has prices, and elsewhere it's unknown whether it sells; and a provider without iconUrl has no logo, so the app shows its first letter.
conventions.ids: Stable slugs: provider 'netflix', plan 'netflix.standard', add-on 'netflix.extra-member', bundle 'bundle.disney-crave-premium', feature 'video.quality'.
conventions.rankKeys: Boolean feature: '<featureId>'. Enum or set value: '<featureId>=<valueId>'. Number tier: '<featureId>=<tierId>'. A plan provides an enum key when its value is at least that value, and a tier key when its number is at least the tier's min (PROJECT-PLAN.md §3.2).
conventions.money: Amounts are decimals in the currency's major unit (18.99 = $18.99). Currencies are ISO 4217. Regions are ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 ('GB', never 'UK'), a group priced once for all its members ('EU'), or 'GLOBAL' for one price wherever the provider sells. A free plan has one price with amount 0: it creates no charges and the app shows it as Free (PROJECT-PLAN.md §3.1).
conventions.pricing: 'prices' lists every stored price for every region. When a request includes region and currency, a 'pricing' array is added with one picked price per interval, all from one source region and currency (pickPrice, BLUEPRINT §4.7). 'native: false' means the amount was converted, and the app shows ≈ and the exchange icon. A free price (0) is always native, with no fx. Whether the item is sold in that region at all is a separate check (availability, BLUEPRINT §4.7). Amounts and monthlyEquivalent are rounded to 2 decimals and fx.rate to 4, from the unrounded conversion.
conventions.monthlyEquivalent: Price per month: year ÷ 12, week × 52 ÷ 12, day × 365 ÷ 12, each divided by intervalCount. Computed from the unrounded amount, then rounded to 2 decimals.
conventions.dates: Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Timestamps are ISO 8601 in UTC.
conventions.caching: GET responses carry an ETag based on the catalog version. Send If-None-Match to get 304 Not Modified.

_about.appUsage: The web app reads the catalog from static files: https://sub.simplely.ca/data/catalog/index.json (the catalog version and the regions with a file of their own), then its region's https://sub.simplely.ca/data/catalog/<region>.json, or /data/catalog.json for a region without one (the same JSON as GET /catalog?region=). Catalog icons are static files too, at https://sub.simplely.ca/icons/<providerId>.png. The only Worker endpoints it calls are GET /fx and GET /icon (for custom subscriptions). The other endpoints serve deep links, future features and other API consumers.
_about.exchangeRatesUsed: Every converted price below uses the GET /fx example: 1 USD = 1.3806 CAD and 1 EUR = 1.5060 CAD (ECB rates for 2026-10-21, illustrative).

GET /health._note: catalogVersion, catalogUpdatedAt and counts describe the catalog D1 holds: the seed writes them when the catalog version changes (BLUEPRINT §5.3), so catalogUpdatedAt is the build time of the first deploy with that version. A D1 that hasn't been seeded yet has none of them, and /health returns only status and apiVersion.

GET /catalog.description: The full catalog snapshot: features, categories, providers (with plans, add-ons and every region's prices) and bundles. Served from the static files the build writes, byte for byte: /data/catalog.json, or a region's /data/catalog/<region>.json. The ETag is the catalog version, the same for every region.

query.region: Optional. An ISO 3166-1 region code, a group (EU) or GLOBAL. Keeps only the prices pickPrice can pick for a buyer there, whatever their currency: for each plan, add-on and bundle, the region's own prices, or else its group's (EU for a Swede). An item priced in neither keeps every price, since any of them can be the fallback. Every item stays, and meta.region names the region. The response is the static file /data/catalog/<region>.json, or the group's file for a country without one of its own; a region with neither gets the full snapshot, without meta.region (BLUEPRINT §6.3).

GET /features.description: The feature registry: every feature, its type, its values or tiers (the rankable options), aliases and headline flags.

data.name: People included
data._note: A plan that doesn't list it is for one person, so there's no single-person tier.

data.name: Includes another subscription
data._note: Values are provider or plan ids (e.g. proton.pass-plus). A plan that lists plans here is a suite, and inclusion is transitive (BLUEPRINT §4.4): overlap warnings, savings and the optimizer use it. Never shown in ranking UIs.

GET /categories.description: Service categories (what a provider is), feature categories (how the Features page groups features) and spend categories (used for card rewards).

GET /providers.description: Search and filter providers. Each result lists the provider's plans that match every filter, with picked prices for the requested region and currency.

query.q: Free text matched against provider and plan names, aliases, feature names and category names.
query.feature: Comma-separated rank keys. A plan must provide all of them. Example: video.quality=4k,streaming.ad-free
query.interval: Only plans that offer this interval: day | week | month | year.
query.region: Region used to pick prices, e.g. CA. Required for price filters and price sorting.
query.currency: Display currency, e.g. CAD. Defaults to the region's main currency.
query.nativeOnly: true = skip plans whose picked price would be converted.
query.sort: relevance (default with q) | price_asc (default without q) | price_desc | name | features

GET /providers/:id.description: One provider with all its plans, add-ons and every region's prices. With region and currency, picked 'pricing' is added to each plan and add-on.

query.currency: Optional, e.g. CAD. Defaults to the region's main currency.

Proton, priced for Canada (converted from USD; a free plan, suite plans, detailed password-manager features and perks)

plans.name: Proton Free
plans._note: A free plan: one price of 0. Its picked price is native, since 0 needs no conversion. It creates no charges and shows as Free, never with ≈ (PROJECT-PLAN.md §3.1). One free account covers every Proton app, so it's one plan.

plans.name: Proton Unlimited
plans.notes: Storage is shared across Proton services.
plans._note: A suite plan (BLUEPRINT §4.4): it states its own features (500 GB, more than any single plan), and includes-subscription lists the plans it replaces. That drives overlap warnings, savings against buying them separately and the optimizer. Trimmed: the real file also lists proton.mail-plus and proton.drive-plus.

plans.name: Proton Duo
plans.notes: Storage is shared between the two users.
plans._note: A suite for two people (account.users: 2). It includes Unlimited, and inclusion is transitive, so it also covers the plans Unlimited includes. It costs more than one Unlimited, so no savings line is shown; the optimizer can still use it to replace two people's Unlimited plans in one list.

GET /plans/:id.description: One plan with a provider summary, its add-ons (expanded), the bundles that include it and the rank keys it provides.

GET /bundles.description: Bundles that include any of the given plans, with computed savings against buying the plans separately and the union of their features.

query.plans: Comma-separated plan ids. Returns bundles containing at least one of them.

data.name: Disney+ Premium & Crave Premium (example bundle)
data._note: features is the union of the included plans: booleans OR'd, numbers and enums take the highest value, sets are merged.

GET /fx.description: Daily ECB exchange rates (Frankfurter), cached at the edge for 12 hours. If Frankfurter is down, the last good rates are returned with meta.stale = true.

query.base: Required. The user's currency, e.g. CAD.

meta._note: 1 CAD = rate × target currency. To convert 5.00 EUR to CAD: 5.00 ÷ 0.6640 = 7.53 (an EUR → CAD rate of 1.5060).

GET /icon.description: Favicon proxy for custom subscriptions (a website the user typed). Asks Google's favicon service, then DuckDuckGo's (core's iconServiceUrls), and returns the best square PNG they give, or the Simply Sub fallback icon. Catalog providers don't use it: their icons are static files at /icons/<providerId>.png.

query.domain: Required. A bare hostname such as localgym.example (no scheme or path).

response._note: The real body is the PNG image bytes. X-Icon-Source is duckduckgo, google or fallback.

details.issue: Expected a bare hostname like 'example.com' (no scheme or path).

POST /cal.description: Creates an opt-in live calendar feed. The app uploads a minimal schedule (titles and dates only) and gets an unguessable feed URL to subscribe to in Google, Apple or Proton Calendar. The server stores nothing else.

meta._note: The app stores token and manageKey locally. manageKey is required to update (PUT) or revoke (DELETE) the feed, and is never shown again.

GET /cal/:token.ics.description: The iCalendar feed that calendar apps subscribe to.

response.body:
BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//Simply Sub//sub.simplely.ca//EN
CALSCALE:GREGORIAN
X-WR-CALNAME:Simply Sub payments
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:0192f1c5-0a11-7e42-8b7c-1f2e3d4c5b6a-20261103@sub.simplely.ca
DTSTAMP:20261022T182000Z
DTSTART;VALUE=DATE:20261103
SUMMARY:Renew Mullvad VPN — ≈ $8.51
END:VEVENT
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:0192f1c4-7b2e-7c3a-9d41-5e8f2a1b3c4d-20261112@sub.simplely.ca
DTSTAMP:20261022T182000Z
DTSTART;VALUE=DATE:20261112
SUMMARY:Netflix — $21.46
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
response._note: One all-day event per charge for the next 12 months, never repeat rules (BLUEPRINT §11.2): the first two are shown. Each UID is the item id plus the charge date. Amounts are what's charged, here with Ontario's 13% HST (BLUEPRINT §4.8).

error.message: This calendar feed doesn't exist or was revoked.

PUT /cal/:token.description: Replaces the feed's events after the user changes their lists. Requires the manage key.

body._note: Same shape as the example above.

error.message: The manage key doesn't match this calendar feed.

DELETE /cal/:token.description: Revokes the feed. Calendar apps stop receiving updates. Requires the manage key.

errorCodes.meaning: A query parameter or body field is missing or invalid. 'details' lists each problem.
Missing or wrong manage key (calendar feeds).
Unknown id, path or calendar token.
Too many requests. Respect the Retry-After header.
A third-party source (such as Frankfurter) failed and no cached copy exists.
Unexpected error. Safe to retry later.
